entries.worked: Qwen is a first-class Pi provider via createProvider + openAICompletionsApi. Keys: QWEN_API_KEY or DASHSCOPE_API_KEY. Base URL: QWEN_BASE_URL or DASHSCOPE_BASE_URL, default DashScope intl compatible-mode. Same BYO-key path as OPENROUTER_API_KEY. Do not remove OpenRouter or qwen-token-plan.

Defaults: PI_DEFAULT_PROVIDER=qwen, PI_DEFAULT_MODEL=qwen-plus. SPARK_GX10_BASE_URL set → provider spark-gx10 / deepseek-v4-flash. Explicit PI_DEFAULT_PROVIDER=openrouter keeps deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-0731.
User-facing name MeshVault. Keep @rakazo/* workspace names. Electron productName MeshVault, appId ai.meshvault.desktop. Expo name/slug/scheme meshvault; API still trusts rakazo:// and meshvault://.
